explanation: Building the Blog/CMS application in Go from an empty repository was seamless. The generated AUTHORING.md and Go SDK documentation clearly explained aggregate routing, relationship proofs, primary-key slug route modeling, dependent tag hydration, and read-after-commit fencing. The source-only check and explicit lock ceremony compiled the contract, four RiffQL queries, role, and Go bindings on the first attempt with zero compiler or runtime errors, and the generated Go client required zero handwritten transport or codec glue.
